column1: # Hebrew (he) catalog for PdfCraft. Columns are context<TAB>English source<TAB>Hebrew translation.
# Clean-room, AI-assisted translations authored from the meaning of PdfCraft's English UI labels.
# Not independently reviewed by a native-language reviewer yet.
# Catalogs remain in logical (typing) order; the existing egui 0.37 fork owns RTL shaping and
# reordering. Do not pre-reverse strings. Keep placeholders and trailing ellipses unchanged.
# Product and technology names such as PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat, JavaScript and Discord stay in Latin.
